comment: v3.1 layers are wired behind flags (off by default). status=working means the code path exists; nothing is uploaded or default-on until Review and owner YES.

layers.label: Live US town boundaries
layers.fallback: Skipped when the service is down or the layer is off.

layers.label: US Census TIGER/Line 2026 (PMTiles)
layers.credit: U.S. Census Bureau, TIGER/Line 2026 (U.S. Government work)
layers.reason: Flag off by default. Toggles in Layers are remembered. Archives are not uploaded until owner YES. Cousub and place archives stop at zoom 10 (z11–13 not built).
layers.fallback: Skipped with a layer-unavailable note when the archive is missing or the host is down.

layers.label: USGS 3DEP terrain
layers.reason: Flag off by default. Toggles in Layers are remembered. Archive is not uploaded until owner YES. Zoom 6 is partial; zooms 7–8 are not in this archive.
layers.fallback: Skipped with a layer-unavailable note when the archive is missing or the host is down. Missing or black tiles keep the current globe elevation.

layers.label: Official UAP records (declassified)
layers.credit: AARO; National Archives (NARA); U.S. Air Force (U.S. government works, public domain). Coordinates: OurAirports (public domain).
layers.reason: Toggle in Layers is off by default and counts as a heavy layer. Historical records only; no live tracking.

layers.label: StarFire sightings
layers.reason: Toggle in Layers is off by default and counts as a heavy layer. Dated archive snapshot only; no live feed and no refresh. State, region or county centroid pins are approximate and are not the sighting position.
